description: This file implements the SmsSender class responsible for sending SMS messages via a modem simulator. It constructs PDU formatted messages and sends AT commands over a socket connection.

classes.name: SmsSender
classes.description: A class responsible for sending SMS messages through a modem simulator interface.

methods.name: SmsSender
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SmsSender with a shared file descriptor to the modem simulator.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Constructs and sends an SMS message in PDU format via the modem simulator, returning true if successful.
